Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: PURPOSE: Recompute a Nivelacija header's totals from its lines. Pure aggregation — changes no line, no price, no status.

Step.name: Insert Text
Step.Text:
PARAMS (JSON): nivelacijaId required.
RETURNS data: the seven totals it wrote.
TOTALS ARE THE SUM OF ROUNDED LINES, never the rounding of a sum — otherwise the printed columns do not add up to the printed total, which is the first thing an accountant checks.
TWO PARALLEL TOTAL SETS, AND BOTH ARE NEEDED: UkupnoRazlika is the GROSS delta. This is the figure the trgovacka knjiga takes. UkupnoRazlikaRUC is the NET delta, and because a nivelacija never touches cost it is identically the movement in razlika u cijeni. This is the figure the printed form shows as "Efekat nivelacije". Under ZadrziMPC the first is zero and the second is not. They are different numbers with different consumers and neither is derived from the other at read time.
NIV__Post does not call this — it recomputes lines from the price-event log and writes its own totals, because a posted document may never inherit a number the UI produced. This script exists for the open-document UI, where the operator wants a live total while editing.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── One aggregate query. The lines already hold rounded values, so SUM over them is the sum of rounded lines by construction. ──

Value.Calculation: epSQLExecute ( "SELECT" & " COUNT ( StavkeNivelacije.PrimaryKey )," & " SUM ( StavkeNivelacije.StaraVrijednost )," & " SUM ( StavkeNivelacije.NovaVrijednost )," & " SUM ( StavkeNivelacije.RazlikaVrijednost )," & " SUM ( StavkeNivelacije.StaraVrijednostBezPDV )," & " SUM ( StavkeNivelacije.NovaVrijednostBezPDV )," & " SUM ( StavkeNivelacije.RazlikaRUC )," & " SUM ( StavkeNivelacije.RazlikaPDV )" & " FROM StavkeNivelacije" & " WHERE StavkeNivelacije.ForeignKeyNivelacijaID = ?" ; "useSQLResult=rs_tot" ; $nivelacijaId )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── The identity that must hold on any nivelacija: the gross delta is exactly the RUC delta plus the PDV delta, because cost never moves. A mismatch means a line was written by something that did not respect the anchor, so it is surfaced as a warning here and as a hard error in NIV__Post. ──
